programmes.d: Ruthann promised her cousin that she would turn their historic house into a bed and breakfast when it was sold to her.
Mary has blown through over $200,000 of an inheritance buying items for the consignment shop she owns. But many of the items never make it from her hoarded home into her cluttered store.
Judy hoarded herself out of her house and used cancer surgery as an excuse to stay with her friend Linda. A few weeks turned into a ten month nightmare of Judy hoarding and squatting in Linda's home.
Stacey has two days to get rid of the 47 dogs and cats that have taken over her house.
The stench emanating from Robin's home can be smelled from the street. The garbage inside is piled from floor to ceiling and the house is literally caving in around it.
It's winter, and Hanna has hoarded herself and her 200 chickens out of her house and is now living with the chickens in a windowless, unheated trailer.
Chickens roam all over Constance's property, where she runs a "fresh egg" operation.
Lloyd's home is so filled that he's been forced to live in one of the many trailers on his property.
19-year-old Andrew's mother is a hoarder, and after living in the hoard his entire life, he has learned no other way to live. Stuck in a hoarded house, with no job, no motivation and no direction.
Beverly has been obsessively recording thousands and thousands of hours of audio and video for decades.
Two hoarders are living in life threatening conditions. Cynthia has a debilitating auto immune disease and lives in a hoard that could make her illness deadly.
A collection of 2500 free-roaming rats have hoarded Glen out of his home and into a shed on his property.
A victim of abuse as a child, Diana's hoarding became so extreme that her daughter was forced to sleep in a recliner because the trash had overtaken her room.
Deborah, a 49-year-old mother of two is living in fear that her hoarding will lead authorities to take her children away again. Her husband Ron is at his wit's end.
Billy Bob's house is so filled with toys and games, puzzles, cars, dolls, and stuffed animals that he can no longer maneuver through the paths.

Andrew's home is an eyesore in a neighborhood of million dollar homes. The exterior and interior are completely hoarded, there's no running water, and Andrew has allowed a homeless man to create a makeshift shelter in his front yard.
In this episode of Hoarders we check in with five hoarders from past seasons: Al lost custody of his son due to his hoarding.
